title: Treasury Admits Insolvency. Bitcoin Already Knew.
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

US Treasury just admitted it's insolvent — $47 trillion liability gap. Bitcoin already priced this in.

Here's the setup: MicroStrategy pulled a billion dollars of Bitcoin off exchanges in a single session. That's structural supply shock hitting post-halving miner issuance cuts. Meanwhile, long-term holders who bought below 50K haven't moved a satoshi through this 10 percent pullback. That's conviction.

The chart's clean. Bitcoin pulled from 74K to 66K, but hash rate held above
